title: 上海光源纳米三维成像线站方法学及?应用研究进展（特邀）

problem_evidence.claim: 上海光源纳米三维成像线站是我国首条自主研制的专用全场透射X 射线显微成像线站，也是国际首条基于弯铁 光源实现20 nm 空间分辨率的硬X 射线成像线站，其工作能量范围为5~14 keV。光束线采用柱面准直镜、双晶单色器及 超环面聚焦镜设计方案，实验站主要配备自主研制的单毛细管椭球聚焦镜、高稳定机械系统、高效率X 射线探测器系统 及控制与数据采集软件，具备全场透射X 射线显微成像、全场纳米CT、X 射线纳米谱学成像、定量双能减影成像等多模态 表征能力。线站自2023 年开放运行以来，已支撑用户完成170 余项实验课题，研究领域涵盖能源材料、半导体器件、光学 元件等方向，产出多项具有国际影响力的研究成果。上海光源纳米三维成像线站已成为我国同步辐射纳米尺度表征的 重要科研平台，为前沿科学研究提供了关键技术支撑。

section_texts.abstract: 上海光源纳米三维成像线站是我国首条自主研制的专用全场透射X 射线显微成像线站，也是国际首条基于弯铁 光源实现20 nm 空间分辨率的硬X 射线成像线站，其工作能量范围为5~14 keV。光束线采用柱面准直镜、双晶单色器及 超环面聚焦镜设计方案，实验站主要配备自主研制的单毛细管椭球聚焦镜、高稳定机械系统、高效率X 射线探测器系统 及控制与数据采集软件，具备全场透射X 射线显微成像、全场纳米CT、X 射线纳米谱学成像、定量双能减影成像等多模态 表征能力。线站自2023 年开放运行以来，已支撑用户完成170 余项实验课题，研究领域涵盖能源材料、半导体器件、光学 元件等方向，产出多项具有国际影响力的研究成果。上海光源纳米三维成像线站已成为我国同步辐射纳米尺度表征的 重要科研平台，为前沿科学研究提供了关键技术支撑。 关键词 X 射线成像；同步辐射；全场透射X 射线显微成像；全场纳米CT；X 射线纳米谱学成像；单毛细管椭球聚焦镜 中图分类号 O434.11 文献标志码 DOI： 10.3788/LOP251906 Progress in Methodologies and Applications of the 3D Nanoimaging Beamline at Shanghai Synchrotron Radiation Facility (Invited) Tao Fen 1,2,3, Zhang Ling 2, Wang Jun 2, Du GuoHao 2, Deng Biao 1,2,3*, Xiao TiQiao 1,2,3 1Shanghai Institute of Applied Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Shanghai 201800, China; 2Shanghai Synchrotron Radiation Facility, Shanghai Advanced Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Shanghai 201204, China; 3University of Chinese Academy of Science, Beijing 100049, China The 3D nano-imaging beamline at the Shanghai synchrotron radiation facility (SSRF) is an in-house-designed dedicated full-field transmission X-ray microscopy (TXM) system in China. It is also the world’s first hard X-ray imaging beamline based on a bending-magnet source to achieve 20 nm spatial resolution, with an energy range of 5‒14 keV. The optical system integrates a cylindrical collimating mirror, double-crystal monochromator, and toroidal focusing mirror. The experimental station is equipped with an in-house designed ellipsoidal mono-capillary condenser, high-stability mechanical systems, high efficiency X-ray detectors and customized control/data acquisition software. The beamline supports multimodal imaging capabilities, including TXM, nano-CT, full-field X-ray nanospectroscopic imaging, and K- edge subtraction computed tomography (KES-CT). Since its commissioning in 2023, the beamline has supported over 170 user experiments across multiple disciplines including energy materials, semiconductor devices, and optical components, yielding numerous internationally recognized research achievements. As a crucial national platform for synchrotron-based nanoscale characterization, the 3D nano-imaging beamline provides essential technical capabilities for cutting-edge scientific research. 像，可与其他实验方法联用，例如可与X 射线吸收谱一 起实现元素价态分析 ［5］。TXM 已成为可见光显微镜 和电子显微镜的重要补充，在多个科学领域成为不可 替代的表征手段。 当前，全球主要同步辐射装置均配置了专用硬X 射 线TXM 线站，如美国NSLS-II（18ID 线站） ［2］，SSRL （BL6-2C） ［6-7］，APS（26ID-C ［8］、32ID-C），韩国PLS-II（7C It is also the world’s first hard X-ray imaging beamline based on a bending-magnet source to achieve 20 nm spatial resolution, with an energy range of 5‒14 keV. The optical system integrates a cylindrical collimating mirror, double-crystal monochromator, and toroidal focusing mirror.

The experimental station is equipped with an in-house designed ellipsoidal mono-capillary condenser, high-stability mechanical systems, high efficiency X-ray detectors and customized control/data acquisition software. The beamline supports multimodal imaging capabilities, including TXM, nano-CT, full-field X-ray nanospectroscopic imaging, and K- edge subtraction computed tomography (KES-CT).

Since its commissioning in 2023, the beamline has supported over 170 user experiments across multiple disciplines including energy materials, semiconductor devices, and optical components, yielding numerous internationally recognized research achievements. As a crucial national platform for synchrotron-based nanoscale characterization, the 3D nano-imaging beamline provides essential technical capabilities for cutting-edge scientific research.

3 高稳定性机械运动系统设计与集成 为实现20 nm 空间分辨率成像目标，主要考虑系 统的稳定性，着重于最小化各类扰动因素，为此系统采 用了模块化设计理念，系统硬件设计主要从以下几个 方面进行： 1） 基础隔振设计：TXM 系统的核心部件集成于 定制化高稳定性光学平台上，该平台长度为4 m，宽度 为1.5 m。 2） 精密运动控制系统：所有光学元件仅保留功能 必需的自由度，其余方向刚性锁定以确保稳定性。椭球 聚焦镜模块包含5 个方向（前后X、左右Y、上下Z、旋转 台W、俯仰倾斜台V 角）自由度的电机，以及用于椭球聚 焦镜振动的扫描台（scan-Y、scan-Z）。针孔与波带片模 块化分别包含3 个方向的自由度（前后X、左右Y、上下 Z）电机。样品台模块包括3个方向自由度（前后X、左右 Y、上下Z）的电机，气浮动旋转台（RT150U， LAB，用于 纳米CT 时候样品转动），以及双压电微位移台 （SLS5252， Smaract，用于将样品精确调至旋转中心）。

2） Nano-CT 和KES-CT 实验模式下，可调节样品 的中心将其与样品台中心对齐，可根据样品情况选择 合适的能量，从而实现多角度投影图像采集。 3） XANES 实验模式下，支持自定义能量扫描范 围和步长设置。由于波带片的焦距随入射X 射线能量 变化，通过两个特征能量拍摄清晰图像，软件根据这两 幅图像中的波带片位置、扫描能量范围和实验所需步 长，自动计算各个能量点对应的波带片位置。实现波 带片位置随单色器能量的动态调整，确保全能量范围 内的成像清晰度。三维XANES 成像时，可在每个能 量点自动完成全套nano-CT 数据采集。

It is also the world’s first hard X-ray imaging beamline based on a bending-magnet source to achieve 20 nm spatial resolution, with an energy range of 5‒14 keV. The optical system integrates a cylindrical collimating mirror, double-crystal monochromator, and toroidal focusing mirror.

The experimental station is equipped with an in-house designed ellipsoidal mono-capillary condenser, high-stability mechanical systems, high efficiency X-ray detectors and customized control/data acquisition software. The beamline supports multimodal imaging capabilities, including TXM, nano-CT, full-field X-ray nanospectroscopic imaging, and K- edge subtraction computed tomography (KES-CT).

Since its commissioning in 2023, the beamline has supported over 170 user experiments across multiple disciplines including energy materials, semiconductor devices, and optical components, yielding numerous internationally recognized research achievements. As a crucial national platform for synchrotron-based nanoscale characterization, the 3D nano-imaging beamline provides essential technical capabilities for cutting-edge scientific research.
